usage: The word '做運動' is used to refer to the activity of exercising or working out.
'做運動' can be used as a noun to describe the action or session of exercise.
It is commonly used both in casual conversation and formal contexts when talking about physical fitness.
'做運動' can appear with time expressions, like '每朝做運動' (exercise every morning).
You often use it with verbs such as 開始 (start), 想 (want), and 喜歡 (like), for example, '我想做運動' (I want to exercise).
